newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota current profit to jump in 1996/97 - Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: Toyota current profit to jump in 1996/97 - Nikkei.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp is expected to post parent current profit of 530 billion yen in the year to March 1997, a 56 percent jump from a previous year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun (Nikkei) reported on Sunday.
In May, Toyota forecast parent current profit of 480 billion yen for 1996/97 against an actual 340.73 billion yen a year earlier.
The strong earnings estimate reflects a substantial improvement in export profitability amid the yen's decline against the dollar and a recovery in domestic sales, Nikkei said.
